evidence: NATO reported that Sweden joined on 7 March 2024 after depositing its instrument of accession with the US government in Washington, DC. Sweden brought the alliance's membership to 32.
headline: Sweden joins NATO
context: Sweden deposited its instrument of accession with the US government in Washington, DC.
why_it_matters: Sweden's accession brought NATO membership to 32 countries.

evidence: NATO reported that Finland joined on 4 April 2023 as its 31st member. Finland deposited its instrument of accession with the US at NATO headquarters in Brussels.
headline: Finland joins NATO
context: Finland deposited its instrument of accession with the US at NATO headquarters in Brussels.
